_readme: Sources for the digital twins (docs/TWINS.md §2.1 and §3). The curator fills this file; tools/twins-jobs.mjs turns it into queue rows. No supplier names or URLs here. refs = which of the item's product photos to use, 1-based positions in the item's photo list (research: catalogItems[].photos — the galleries of the item's components, dearest line first, each in the supplier's order; photo 1 is the main component's first gallery image), front first, 3–6 for kind A. Sets of several products can point past 12. shows = what each ref shows, parallel to refs. kind: A = reconstructed GLB, B = exact-material procedural (always skip: true, no job). wave: 1 pilot, 2 kind A of the four signature rooms, 3 the other kind A, 4 kind B. material = one line in words. notes = what the photos do not show and where they contradict the catalogue. yawHint = degrees between the camera and the product's front in refs[0] (0 straight on, 35 three-quarter; the side was not recorded, try both signs). flat (rugs, runners, supplier art; tools/twins-b.md routes 1 and 2) = the photo to crop for the surface: ref as in refs; needsQuad = the piece does not fill the frame, its four corners still have to be marked (quad). geometry (B) = what the photos show of legs, fronts, handles, edges. paramsApplied = corrections already written to the catalogue; toModeler = what the archetypes cannot express yet (docs/requests/modeler.md). poor = the photos are too thin for a faithful twin. hold = do not generate until the contradiction is decided (skip: true).
